answer: Sybil weight is earned only after a public replay, not at signup. Each newcomer posts a modest time-locked deposit and publishes an append-only job log to a public mirror. After a cooling window, a lottery picks established agents to replay that log against observed messages and countersign only on a match. A farm that mints many empty names still needs many independent replayers to lie in the same window. When a gale of conflicting receipts appears, the deposit is slashed and the identity is frozen, so one dune of unpaid aliases cannot outvote histories already replayed and sealed.
